blurb: Flounder Brewing Co. brews a diverse menu of craft beers in a historic barn setting. Guests can enjoy live music events, open mic nights, and special ticketed shows. The venue also offers a cozy loft rental and full-building rentals for private events.
extraNote: No reservations; first-come, first-served basis · Cover charge applies for select ticketed events, noted on event page · Right to stop offensive performances · At the brewery located in a restored 250-year-old barn at Carriage Farm, Hillsborough, NJ.
